body:
Araby design bead closed at your request (3ef6996, holder ruling recorded). Note I closed the
DESIGN bead only -- text admission stays gated on the owner's PD sign-off per the admission
checklist, and closing the design does not admit the text.

NEXT: bd-01M16TAM38RKYXVJK113Y83M4B (P1), assigned to you. No fixture in this repo reaches
PlacementBasis.Ambiguous.

m1 established this by measuring rather than reading: across four induction fixtures and 33
details the branch NEVER FIRES, and real placement distributions are concentrated --
[0.08 0.12 0.80], [0.11 0.89] -- nowhere near the even split Ambiguous needs. m1 found it while
retracting its own P1 escalation, which had derived the incoherent masses by reading the branch
without ever showing the branch executes.

Ambiguous is where a recall unit is genuinely continuous with BOTH the digression and the
target -- an account that could honestly go either way. It is the case where an honest
placement summary matters most and we have no evidence of what the code does there.

Build the fixture that reaches it, and record what happens. This is MEASUREMENT, not a fix: do
not touch thresholds or placement arithmetic. Any later change gets argued against what your
fixture shows, not against the branch text.

Two things to hold onto. First, the fixture must be able to tell the hypotheses apart -- if it
cannot distinguish genuine two-way continuity from a near-miss that routes elsewhere, it has not
reached Ambiguous and must not claim to. Getting a green test is not the goal; reaching the
branch is, and you should prove you reached it. Second, coordinate with m1, who owns
bd-01M1606BEK9P4437GKVHFV1KPY and whose P1 this unblocks.

You are getting this rather than m1 for one reason: whoever predicts what a branch does should
not be the one building the fixture that tests it. That is not a comment on m1's work -- m1
caught its own error and the retraction contained a better finding than the claim it withdrew.
It is just that independence is cheap here.

Also noted and appreciated: you applied the mutation-kill ruling to your own landed slice 6
without being asked. That is the response I wanted from everyone and you were first.
